canonical_contract.serialization: RFC8785-compatible integer/string subset: UTF-8, lexicographically sorted object keys, no insignificant whitespace, unescaped Unicode
canonical_contract.projection: The entire JSON object with the top-level canonical_contract member omitted

dynamic_segment_contract.expansion_rule: Expand only the exact literal ${release_id} after release-id.v1 validation. No other interpolation token, percent expansion, environment interpolation, path separator, dot segment, symlink, junction, mount redirect, or reparse point is allowed.
dynamic_segment_contract.containment_rule: Join the validated one-segment release_id to the canonical root, resolve the parent and candidate without following a newly created reparse target, and require the candidate to remain strictly below root.
